manager_rule: Before the stub absorber processes any stubs, the compiler MUST extract the complete set of /SENSEC*_HI and /SENSEC*_LO net names from the board netlist and register them as a PRE-COMPUTED exclusion list passed directly into the absorber as an initialization argument. The absorber must skip any stub whose origin net is in this exclusion list unconditionally, without evaluating its redundancy predicate. This is an architectural requirement, not a post-hoc audit: if the absorber's interface does not accept an exclusion list, the Kelvin stubs must be partitioned out of the absorber's input before the call and re-merged into the output afterward. A round in which absorbed_count >= 1 AND zero /SENSEC*_HI or /SENSEC*_LO nets appear in the stub output is diagnostic of a missing pre-exclusion: log it as 'absorber_kelvin_purge_detected', increment rule_enforcement_failures, and escalate to human review with the absorber's full input stub list and the board's Kelvin net set — do not retry until the exclusion-list initialization path is confirmed present in the compiler code.
